instruction: Make a duplicate of the 'my_documents' folder located on the Desktop, calling the new folder 'my_documents_backup'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires copying a directory to create a backup with a new name. Evaluator checks if the copied directory exists using shell command. Similar difficulty to original (single file system operation). Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter, no custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: The evaluator checks both requirements - (1) the directory 'my_documents_backup' exists, and (2) its content matches the original 'my_documents' directory
The shell command uses 'diff -r' to recursively compare both directories, which will only succeed if the directories have identical content and structure
The logical flow is correct: [ -d check ] && diff -r && echo 'Copy verified' || echo 'Copy failed' ensures all conditions must pass
The getter (vm_command_line) can execute the shell command and return output, and the metric (exact_match) correctly compares the output to the expected value 'Copy verified\n'
The evaluator will correctly fail if: (a) the backup directory doesn't exist, (b) the directories have different content, or (c) the diff command finds any differences
